actual: A single loop can make the Windows desktop unresponsive; batch_size does not bound the daily N-by-N attention and evaluation unnecessarily builds Autograd graphs.
closure_requirements: Exclusive GAT full-train scheduling must not depend on an optional phase-pipeline request.
GPU-resident execution and industry-provider failures must fail explicitly without changing execution mode.
Chunked attention must preserve full-market training semantics while avoiding saved C-by-N attention blocks.
Keep BUG JSON and GitHub Issue synchronized.

expected: A single GAT loop remains desktop-responsive while preserving dense full-market attention and training semantics; exclusive GAT training is durable even when the optional phase-pipeline toggle is false; GPU-resident and provider failures are fail-fast; checkpointed query chunks reduce saved Autograd storage without changing forward, gradient, optimizer-update, or fixed-seed fit/predict results.
non_goals: Do not restart production runtime services without explicit approval.
